name: Spectrier
flavorText: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
description: Spectrier is the Swift Horse Pokémon, a Ghost-type first discovered in the Galar region. It is an extremely rare Legendary Pokémon! It stands 6'07" (2.0 m) tall and weighs 98.1 lbs (44.5 kg). As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
